verdict.rationale: Entra ID ships its own background automation in two places. Lifecycle Workflows contain processes that "run automatically against users" across the joiner/mover/leaver lifecycle, and app provisioning automatically syncs users and groups into SaaS apps. Both are limited to identity-governance tasks rather than general-purpose user-defined automations, and the evidence shows no documented recurring schedule, custom triggers, or agent-driven autonomy. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation authoring beyond identity lifecycle, documented recurring scheduling and trigger configuration, AI/agent-driven autonomous execution, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Workflows contain specific processes that run automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle.
Lifecycle workflows (LCW) are identity governance capabilities that enable organizations to manage Microsoft Entra users across the three phases of a user's lifecycle with an organization
enable automatic provisioning of users and groups between your application and Microsoft Entra ID
